purpose: Per-URL record of real content changes (SG-07). A page's lastmod changes ONLY when that page's content, key links, or structured facts change — build changes, unrelated commits, and date-only edits never bump it. frontend/functions/[[path]].js (STATIC_SITEMAP_ENTRIES) mirrors this file; tests assert the sync. llms.txt / llms-full.txt stay recorded here as a content-change log but are intentionally NOT sitemap entries (text/plain assets do not belong in XML sitemaps). Update the manifest and the functions mirror together in the same change.
